title: Camps — Record refund (pass 1 step 3, R1-05)
subtitle: Hand money back to a family that paid more than the total. The refund is saved as its own line, so Finance shows it on the day it was handed back, in its Refunds group. Copied from Star testing's Record refund (its words, its box, its place in the ⋯). Real preview screens: April Vacation Camp, with the preview set to Wed, Apr 21, 2027. Chloe Martin paid $315 by check on Mar 11; Friday was then taken off with Edit details, so her total is now $292 and she paid $23 more. The new parts are drawn on top for this picture only; nothing is built yet. Amber = new or changed.

row.caption: Camper detail, overpaid: the amber line, and a hint that sends admins to Edit payment.

footer:
How it was drawn: mock-x7-refund.js puts Star testing's real Record refund box (captured from the preview's Fall Star Testing) on the camp page with Camps' words; the ⋯ items, the toast, the History line, the receipt line and the Undo box use the real markup.

Database: a new migration (0039) adds the refund — admins only, never more than what was overpaid, logged; Undo reverses it. Finance adds camp refunds to its Refunds group afterwards. Nothing goes live before you paste the migration.
